result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no critical layout or functionality problems. Only a couple of minor cosmetic inconsistencies were found.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon styling is inconsistent between cards. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart sits inside a white circle, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards have inconsistent thumbnail backgrounds (the Green Bowl Poké card uses a light gray background while the others use dark backgrounds), creating a slightly uneven visual row.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background/image treatment across all cards in the carousel for a more uniform appearance.
